value.rationale: Local-to-global rigidity of pointwise algebra symmetries is a natural structural problem. The first three-dimensional nonunital truncated polynomial example admits a complete field-by-field local-automorphism group classification, explicit finite-field orders, a characteristic-two coupling absent in the standard triangular form, and a sharp iff criterion identifying F2. These are substantial boundary data for extending known characteristic-zero local-automorphism results and cannot be read off from genuine automorphism counts.
